description: For a user-requested plan opening, read get_checklist and get_expenses too; briefly summarize current dates, places, tasks and balances, then offer one contextual next step in the user's language. No identity is needed to read; never guess personal debts. After a write, just report that result instead of repeating the overview. Open the interactive lesgooo planner. Optionally choose a saved plan link, module and previously selected participant credentials. Credentials preserve that person in the displayed view without another identity picker. Without a plan, show the same local draft as the web application; never save a shared plan automatically.

participant_id.description: Previously selected participant in this plan; requires participant_token.

participant_token.description: Token returned by join_plan/create_plan for this participant and plan; requires participant_id.

name: open_planner
title: lesgooo
